verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README says the open-source Python library lets you automate the web 'with any LLM' (browser-use-gh-3). A community user independently reports running it with a Gemini model and notes it is compatible with more models than alternatives (browser-use-comm-1). The open-source library is the documented path for running a local agent (browser-use-docs-19). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs listing supported providers and showing how to configure them, and evidence on whether the Cloud Agent API allows model choice or is limited to Browser Use-managed models.
